name: The Clockwork Parrot of Time's Square
description: A magnificent mechanical parrot with iridescent blue and gold feathers perches on a giant, ornate clock face in a bustling, timeless town square.
prompt: A detailed and lively steampunk scene of a grand town square at golden hour. At the center stands a massive, ornate clock tower, its face as wide as a building. Perched prominently on the clock's hand is a magnificent mechanical parrot, its body crafted from polished brass and copper, with intricate gears visible beneath its colorful, articulated metal feathers that shimmer in shades of emerald green, sapphire blue, and bright gold. The parrot's eyes are glowing sapphires. Around the square, stylized figures in period and futuristic clothing mingle, and vintage airships float in the distance. Warm, inviting light bathes the entire copper-and-stone scene. Highly detailed digital illustration with rich textures and colors.
caption: He's not just keeping time—he's the keeper of stories from every second. What tale would he tell you? ⏳🦜
